<timestamp>Tuesday, Sep 29, 2026, 10:35 AM (UTC+5:30)</timestamp>
<user_query>
Find my Jira projects and list their keys
</user_query>
I'll look for Jira integrations and any stored credentials so I can list your project keys.

I cannot list your Jira project keys from this session. There is **no Jira or Atlassian MCP** connected here, and this workspace has **no Jira config, tokens, or project keys**.

Available tools right now are Cursor Origin, the IDE browser, Playwright, and general web search — none of those can query your Jira account.

To pull project keys from here, you would need one of:

1. **Atlassian / Jira MCP** enabled in Cursor (Settings → MCP), then ask again.
2. **Site + credentials** you already have (Cloud site URL + API token), so the REST call `GET /rest/api/3/project/search` can be used.
3. **Your Jira site URL** if you want me to walk you through listing keys in the UI (`https://<yoursite>.atlassian.net/jira/projects`).

If you add the Jira MCP or share the site URL (and a way to authenticate), I can list the keys.
